name: Young People
overview: Scripture encourages young people to live with intentional holiness by cleansing their ways through adherence to God's Word, which serves as a guiding lamp and light for their path. They are called to trust wholeheartedly in the Lord rather than their own understanding, remembering their Creator early in life before difficult days come. God promises His presence, strength, and help to sustain them, assuring a future filled with hope and peace according to His good plans.
